en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white (with blue-green tint) photograph of a large institutional-looking building with a gabled roof, seen across a bridge and trees in a wintery or early spring landscape. The postcard has printed text at the bottom: 'Skara, Seminariet från Brogården.' Handwritten script covers part of the lower section. The back is labeled 'BREVKORT' in old Swedish, with a green postage stamp from Sweden, postmarked in 'SKARA,' and is addressed to 'Fru Fanny Melin' in 'Vänersborg.'
